Record Class SecuritySearchQuery

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.connector.securitysearch.SecuritySearchQuery
Record Components:
isin - ISIN of the instrument, may be null
currency - trading currency, may be null when unknown
mic - MIC of the listing exchange, may be null when unknown
ticker - ticker symbol used as a fallback query, may be null
name - name of the instrument, may be null; not used by the current providers
maxResults - upper bound of the candidates a single provider returns
public record SecuritySearchQuery(String isin, String currency, String mic, String ticker, String name, int maxResults) extends Record
What is known about an instrument when a provider search is started. The ISIN is the primary key of the search; currency and MIC narrow it down and may be unknown, for example during a transaction import. Ticker and name are only hints for a fallback query and never count as identity.

The compact constructor trims every value, upper-cases ISIN and MIC, turns blank strings into null and replaces a non-positive result limit by DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS. The currency keeps its case, because minor units such as GBp are distinguished by it.

    • hasValidIsin

      public boolean hasValidIsin()
      Tells whether the query carries a syntactically valid ISIN. Providers that place the ISIN into a URL or a filter expression rely on this check, so an arbitrary string never reaches the provider.
      Returns:
      true when the ISIN consists of a two-letter country code, nine alphanumeric characters and a check digit
